candidate_evidence.quote: The objective of the study is to determine whether the combined use of intraoperative fluorescence with 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) and sonography can achieve a higher rate of gross total resection
Surgeon intraoperatively assesses extent of tumor resection observing it's fluorescence in microscope and performing sonography

role_evidence.quote: intraoperative use of 5-aminolevulinic acid induced fluorescence.
Extent of tumor resection will be intraoperatively assessed using fluorescence with 5-aminolevulinic acid

coder_notes: Phase NA surgical/imaging-guidance trial; registered interventions are devices only. Glioblastoma is not named anywhere (only 'high-grade glioma' and 'Glioma, Malignant'), plus brain metastases. 5-ALA is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it for fluorescence-guided resection, so listed as diagnostic_agent.
